text:
Anya (Partnerships): Heads-up — shadow cohort for the new SI onboarding runs next Tue/Wed. Need final sign-off on lab access, trainer pairing, and cert exam windows.
Sam (SI Program): Thanks. Are we locking hardware nodes from HW partner for dedicated lanes?
Anya (Partnerships): Yes, asked Orbix (our HW partner) for 4 A100 nodes reserved 8am-2pm PT both days. They said tentative yes — waiting formal PO.
Leo (DevEx): For lab creds: we can create time-limited accounts via our lab-provisioner. Need list of SI emails + required perms.
Maria (Training Ops): Put me on the list for proctor scheduling. We also need room for the simulated outage walkthru and canary failover lab.
Ryan (SI Lead): I'll push the SI roster today: 12 seats, 3 trainers, mixed integrator backgrounds. Also want marketplace listing walkthrough included.
Sam (SI Program): Can someone add the certification rubric to the playbook? Right now it's a separate doc. We should embed the pass/fail criteria and sample scenarios.
Anya (Partnerships): Good call. We should version the playbook. New section: "Shadow Cohort v1.2" with exam rubric, trainer checklist, and escalation matrix.
Leo (DevEx): I can patch the playbook and add code snippets for quickstart. Example snippet for the lab VM access token rotation:
```bash
# generate ephemeral token
curl -X POST https://lab.internal/redwood/tokens -d '{"user":"si_user@example.com","ttl":3600}'
```
Maria (Training Ops): Also need recording consent forms sent to SIs. lms-bot can auto-send and track completions?
lms-bot: Reminder: cohort consent email template v3 available at https://intranet.redwood/lms/templates/shadow-cohort-v3
Sam (SI Program): Great — action items: Ryan to share roster by EOD, Anya to confirm PO with Orbix by tomorrow noon, Leo to provision time-limited accounts once roster posted, Maria to schedule proctors + send consent via lms-bot.
Ryan (SI Lead): Roster posted: attached in DM. Also flagged two SIs needing VPN exceptions — @eng-security to approve.
Anya (Partnerships): For marketplace walkthrough: who can cover supplier onboarding & listing best practices? Leo, can you and Sam tag-team a 20m session?
Leo (DevEx): Yep — I can do a 15m demo + 10m Q&A. Will add slides to the playbook.
Maria (Training Ops): Final ask: trainer pairing matrix — please confirm one senior trainer per 4 SIs. If anyone wants to swap days ping me.
Sam (SI Program): I'll update the sprint board with tasks and link to the playbook. Also setting up a quick rehearse call Fri @ 9am PT.
Anya (Partnerships): Lovely. If Orbix PO doesn't clear, fallback is shared instance with reduced parallelism — we'll prioritize cert exam runs.
Ryan (SI Lead): Noted. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Maria (Training Ops): Sending calendar invites now :calendar: 
Anya (Partnerships): Closing loop: will post a final checklist here once all items green.
Sam (SI Program): thanks, closing out on my side too :thumbsup:
